results.title: AAKHRI MULAQAT
results.overview: Aakhri Mulaqat follows a photojournalist's investigation into an illegal fake antibiotics racket. Meanwhile, tensions between two rival gangs escalate, fuelled by greed and revenge. As violence brings one conflict to an end, it sets the stage for another, in a cycle that never truly ends.

results.title: GALDR
results.overview: After joining GALDR, a dating app for magical folk, a young man posing as a Druid matches with a mysterious witch for a seemingly ordinary first date. But as the night unfolds, he's pulled into a world of danger and magical chaos far beyond what he could have ever expected.

results.title: Winter Wind
results.overview: When a ghostly stranger warns them of a deadly wind storm, a gang of thieves takes shelter in the very town they once robbed.

results.title: Tannenbaum
results.overview: Jake’s winter season takes an unexpected turn as he tries his best to give his daughter, ex-wife, and dog a memorable Christmas Day.

results.title: Stalling
results.overview: Minutes before a job interview, a man with a stubborn case of shy bladder becomes the center of an increasingly surreal restroom spectacle as every well-intention attempt to help only makes things worse.

results.title: Spatial
results.overview: A sound-forward story that follows Henri Beckett, a reclusive, audio field recordist who captures a chilling occurrence during one of her ambient sessions.

results.title: Smoke
results.overview: When a powerful political wife kidnaps the young woman she suspects is having an affair with her husband, a tense spring afternoon of weed, whiskey, and psychological warfare spirals into a deadly loyalty test.

results.title: Max Capacity
results.overview: While packing up her family home, a woman and her boyfriend discover her dead dad’s nude centerfold.

results.title: The Man I Love
results.overview: Every year, on the eve of the 1973 UpStairs Lounge fire in New Orleans, a man returns to the house he shared with his lover who still waits to say goodbye all over again.

results.title: The King of Time
results.overview: An overworked man goes to cabin in the woods hoping to fall into a time loop.

results.title: The Jade Stallion
results.overview: At a small-town liquor store, a longtime manager struggles to maintain his authority over a younger employee as the balance of power between them begins to shift.

results.title: Hours to Minutes to Seconds
results.overview: A young teenager lives in a house with The Clockmaker. When a new friend comes to life, they discover The Clockmaker is not as altruistic as he seems.

results.title: Harvested
results.overview: After a night of partying, newly graduated medical student Dr. Michael wakes up in an ice-bath with his kidney stolen and must go on an absurd quest to get it back.

results.title: The Great White Wolf
results.overview: A recovering alcoholic is accidentally served a cocktail during a lunch meeting, leading to a relapse depicted through nightly transformations into the Great White Wolf.

results.title: Grad Night
results.overview: A graduation tape from the Class of 2001 captures one last night of freedom and the beginning of a relationship that will shape a lifetime.

results.title: Fruits of Our Labor
results.overview: Tensions rise and plans derail when a group of experienced art thieves reluctantly team up with a rookie informant.

results.title: Doom Lift
results.overview: When a man and a purple puppet find themselves stuck on a runaway ski lift, they try everything to escape, but each action only brings them closer to their doom!

results.title: Abnegation
results.overview: In a world irreversibly damaged by Al data centers, a couple is forced to rely on the very same tool responsible for creating resource scarcity. With the Al in her ear and her thoughts, a wife faces an irrevocable choice.

results.title: The Day I Met Aretha Franklin
results.original_title: The Day I Met Aretha Franklin
results.overview: Two women in a beauty salon transform a playwright’s day before his play world premieres.

results.title: Carolina Blue
results.overview: On the cusp of adulthood, A 19-year-old woman who keeps putting off her life is forced into action when her grandfather stops putting off his, setting her on a journey to find him.
